messages:
Sam: incident-bot just fired a canary-latency page, PD escalation came through, tagging oncall
Incident Bot: page fired — canary-latency > 250ms (p95) across canary cluster (count=7 in 90s)
PagerDuty: PagerDuty incident PD-84721 triggered (urgent)
Sam: acked in PD, i'm looking
Morgan: taking over from Sam, leave notes in thread pls
Sam: quick context — only canary routes (/canary/*) affected, prod routes look normal. no 5xx spikes in logs. traces point to intermittent kv-cache miss + cold-starts
Lee: canary nodes show short CPU spikes and long gc pauses on one host
Sam: scaling canary runtime from 2 -> 5 now: `kubectl scale deploy/canary-runtime --replicas=5`
infra-bot: scaling canary-runtime: desired=5 -> rolling update started (3 pods terminating, 3 creating)
Sam: also flipping canary model fallback to smaller variant temporarily: `route /canary -> model: rwd-3b-quant`
Morgan: good. i'll watch latency dashboards and traces. Sam, keep PD acknowledged until we confirm stable
Incident Bot: alert threshold cleared — canary-latency p95 back under 250ms
PagerDuty: PD-84721 auto-resolved by monitoring (metric stable)
Lee: we got a second page ~35s after resolve (flap) — looks like another brief warmup spike on a different host
Sam: yep saw that. two short spikes on two hosts within 2m => flapping alert churn
Morgan: customer impact? any user-facing delays?
Sam: no customer impact found; only synthetic canary requests. application logs show successful responses, just higher tail latency during warmup windows :white_check_mark:
Lee: suggested mitigation — increase alert window and add dedupe so PD doesn't escalate for single-window blips
Sam: proposal (will PR):
```
alert_name: canary-latency
condition: p95 > 250ms
window: 3m   # currently 1m
min_alerts: 2 # require two consecutive windows
route: monitoring -> notify(eng-oncall) -> escalate(PD)
```
Sam: opening change now (PR: infra/monitoring#462)
infra-bot: PR infra/monitoring#462 opened by Sam — adding guardrail for canary flapping
Morgan: ok ship after short observation. also add a suppression window for PD so it waits 30s before notifying humans after auto-resolve
Sam: noted. i'll add PD dedupe settings and update runbook entry (canary-warmup.md)
Lee: out of curiosity, what's causing the warmup jitter? anyone seen recent image churn or kernel updates on the host pool?
Sam: tracing shows a KV prefill race on cold start, working with runtime team to add slight pre-warm delay and more robust prefetch
Morgan: thanks. for now set alert severity -> page only if min_alerts satisfied. that should cut the noise and PD churn
Sam: PD escalation rule patched in staging, will roll to prod after 10m of stable metrics
Morgan: confirmed no customer-facing incidents. marking incident as no-impact and monitoring for 15m :thumbsup:
Sam: all done for now, will follow up in PR and runbook. tag me if it flaps again @oncall
Morgan: closing thread if stable — nice quick triage team :clap:
